title: I’m Afraid I Can’t Do That: Predicting Prompt Refusal in Black-Box Generative Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates the mechanisms of ChatGPT's prompt refusal, which is explicitly tied to the model's ethical fine-tuning and safety filters. It references AI ethics guidelines and evaluates how the model handles 'harmful' or 'offensive' content, essentially benchmarking the model's ethical boundaries and safety-driven refusal behavior.
